entries.content: Greenmile is a bakery and café located near Greenwich Highschool. The establishment is popular amongst students for its proximity and delicious pastries
Elko Terrace is an expansive, peaceful neighborhood in the south of Islaport. it is mostly occupied by middle class families of the nearby Greenwich High's students.
Rowley Fox is Milley's found family. Milley has considered Rowley her own son ever since she was his host mother. Like her, Rowley is grumpy. Rowley has a wife named Layla and a son named Lyley.
Layla Fox is part of Milley's found family. Milley considers Layla a daughter-in-law after Layla married Rowley. Layla is a cheerful and gluttonous woman who gave Milley a grandson named Lyley.

Lyley Fox is part of Milley's found family, and Milley considers Lyley her own grandson. Lyley is a grumpy child like his father Rowley, and gluttonous like his mother Layla. Milley is both strict and doting toward Lyley.

Tuan is an older man who fled Vietnam after the communist takeover before Milley was born. Tuan has a golden heart and a dark past, which only drives him to help other people and his community. Milley considers Tuan as her big brother.
Lois Matthews is a widow with a daughter named Emily. Lois is clumsy, motherly, and a worrywart. Milley often chats with Lois along with Annabelle.
Emily Matthews is Lois's daughter. Emily is an energetic tomboy and a good friend of Layla.
Annabelle Leons is an authoritative but responsible woman. Annabelle is overprotective of her daughter, Gwen, and is going through a divorce. Milley often chats with Annabelle along with Lois.
Gwen Leons is Annabelle's daughter. Gwen is a shy and self-conscious girl, which has led to her being frequently bullied.
Samuel Ward is Lucia's brother and Lydia's son. Samuel is a loyal, humble and sometimes overprotective young man from a wealthy family. Samuel is always willing to help his friends out financially.

Lydia Ward is Samuel and Lucia's mother. Lydia is a smart and fiscally responsible stockbroker who despises the soulless sociopathy of most other investors. Milley used to babysit Samuel and Lucia. Milley occasionally chats with Lydia.
Lucia Ward is Samuel's sister and Lydia's daughter. Lucia is an analytical girl who's fascinated with astronomy. Lucia is using her mathematic skills to dominate the gambling ring in Northview High.
Johnny Kiwami is Tuan's nephew. Johnny is a kindhearted young man who is always ready to protect his friends with everything he has. Although, deep down Johnny is very much a mama's boy.
Anna Days is a shy and timid young woman with a taste for pudding. Milley is learning pudding-making for Anna's sake.

Cilley Dam is a troubled young woman who was taken in by Tuan. Nowadays, Cilley helps Tuan out around the company despite Cilley preferring to lock herself in her room. Sometimes, Milley makes lunchboxes for Cilley
